description.value: The Ruddy on Bowen is an independent grocery store and café that has served Bowen Island's Snug Cove since 1997, situated within walking distance of the ferry terminal at Horseshoe Bay. It combines a full market — fresh produce, local meats and seafood, artisanal bakery, and specialty cheeses — with a café serving freshly brewed coffee and ready-made meals to go. The store has a sustainability focus, including a soap refill station and a sharewares reusable cup program.
